body: -- Founder: 'build out mashup nomination as a social tool.' New mashup_nominations table, MashupNominationsHandler (create/list/review), promptoverse.mashups.review permission, frontend widget on every subject page (autocomplete + Google Sign-In via existing ID-token flow, no gate.farthq.com dependency). 16 new tests. Live-verified through the real HTTPS path (widget renders, GET/POST endpoints respond correctly, unauthenticated POST 401s). Blocked on a real GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID (human action, Google Cloud Console) before sign-in actually works -- widget shows a clear not-yet-available state until then. Commit 41a21b0.
title: Mashup nomination social tool built and live-verified
